Predominantly deep navy #153449, cobalt #285B9A, muted teal #4A8C94, pale blue #DCEAF0 and warm ivory #F5F3EC, with tiny muted ochre or warm-brick accents when appropriate. Quiet, intelligent and tangible; no childish cartoon, glossy 3D or photorealism.
